pub fn push(cursor: &mut Cursor, bytes: &[u8]) -> Result<()>
test_vectors: Both payload ownership variants and both cursor modes: independent input copy, unchanged initial traversal state, no eager validation.
Nested object and array with true, false, null, exponent number, string and empty object: exact event order, spans and delimiter offsets.
Scalar roots, empty string, empty object and empty array.
Every two-chunk split of a nested document containing multibyte UTF-8, escaped keys, escaped backslashes and quotes, surrogate pairs, numbers and keywords, in both modes.
Bytewise feeds with overwritten caller chunks, empty feeds and retained raw and decoded string references.
Partial surrogate-pair string: repeated NeedMore preserves current and token offset, no partial arena writes, exactly one decoded string.
NeedMore and repeated Finished preserve current; EOF declarations do not consume events and are idempotent.
Numbers and keywords wait for a delimiter or confirmed EOF.
Empty and whitespace-only documents defer UnexpectedEof until traversal.

Malformed containers, trailing commas, invalid keys, mismatched delimiters, extra roots, truncated literals, invalid numbers, unclosed strings, invalid escapes, lone surrogates, control bytes, invalid UTF-8 and decoded duplicate keys propagate exactly the syntax parser's errors.
Explicit absolute offsets for UnexpectedEof, UnclosedString, TrailingContent and InvalidSyntax.
Inclusive and zero payload limits; failed chunk append preserves storage and parser position and creates a sticky failure.
Zero and exact depth limits, inclusive array item and object field limits, and limit failures in query mode.
Empty and nonempty pushes after EOF or successful completion return sticky syntax errors without changing current or input.
Suspended skip rejects traversal without mutation, permits feeding and EOF, and permits traversal after the skip owner completes it.
A sticky syntax failure arising during suspended skip takes precedence over the recoverable cursor misuse error.
